newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil, workers reach tentative deal.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil, workers reach tentative deal.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd and workers at its 112,000 barrel per day Nanticoke, Ontario refinery reached a tentative labor agreement early on Tuesday, possibly averting a strike at the plant, a company spokesowman said.
"It has not been ratified, but that's the next step," the spokeswoman said.
The refinery's 160 workers who are represented by the Canadian Energy and Paperworkers union were expected to vote on the collective agreement later Tuesday and early Wednesday, she said.
The collective agreement would be the refinery employees' first since the union was certified last January.
The plant at Nanticoke, located about 100 km southwest of Toronto, is Imperial's third-largest refinery.
